description: Make self a real reflexive noun rather than a generic object whose printable description is literally 'you', and expose Zork only as a nonphysical parser-interface noun token

replacements.old:
<OBJECT ME
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM ME MYSELF SELF CRETIN)
	(DESC "you")
	(FLAGS ACTORBIT)
	(ACTION CRETIN-FCN)>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT ME
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM ME MYSELF SELF YOU CRETIN)
	(DESC "yourself")
	(FLAGS ACTORBIT)
	(ACTION CRETIN-FCN)>

<OBJECT ZORK-INTERFACE
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM ZORK)
	(DESC "Zork")
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT)
	(ACTION ZORK-INTERFACE-FCN)>

<ROUTINE ZORK-INTERFACE-FCN ()
	 <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
		<TELL "Zork is the interface through which you address the adventure, not a physical thing in the world." CR>)
	       (T <RFALSE>)>>

replacements.old:
(<VERB? MAKE>
		<TELL "Only you can do that." CR>)
replacements.new:
(<VERB? COMMAND>
		<TELL "You are already in command of yourself." CR>)
	       (<AND <VERB? PUT PUT-ON> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME>>
		<TELL "You cannot put yourself ">
		<COND (<VERB? PUT-ON> <TELL "on ">)
		      (T <TELL "into ">)>
		<TELL "the " D ,PRSI "." CR>)
	       (<VERB? MAKE>
		<TELL "Only you can do that." CR>)
